mapper.select: SELECT id, initialized_at AS initializedAt FROM bootstrap_control WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE bootstrap_control SET initialized_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), initialized_by_employee_id=#{employeeId}, version=version+1, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=1 AND initialized_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT role_code,scope_type,scope_id FROM role_assignment WHERE employee_id=#{employeeId} AND revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

SELECT r.scope_id FROM role_assignment r JOIN team t ON t.id=r.scope_id AND t.status='ACTIVE' WHERE r.employee_id=#{employeeId} AND r.role_code='TEAM_MANAGER' AND r.scope_type='TEAM' AND r.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.scope_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE primary_team_id=#{teamId} AND status='ACTIVE'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) FROM employee e JOIN team t ON t.id=e.primary_team_id JOIN role_assignment r ON r.employee_id=e.id WHERE e.status='ACTIVE' AND t.status='ACTIVE' AND r.role_code='PLATFORM_ADMIN' AND r.scope_type='GLOBAL' AND r.scope_id=0 AND r.revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET display_name=#{displayName}, primary_team_id=#{primaryTeamId}, status=#{status}, version=version+1, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role_assignment(employee_id,role_code,scope_type,scope_id,revoked_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{employeeId},#{roleCode},#{scopeType},#{scopeId},NULL,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE revoked_at=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
